profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Software Synergy
profile.summary:
* 15+ years of proven experience encompassing all aspects of the software 
  engineering lifecycle, from requirements and customer interactions through 
  successful production deployment. 
* Successfully executed jobs functions across management, development, and 
  administrative domains as a Senior Staff member of a small company for 10 
  years.
* Adept at finding innovative and complete solutions to problems.
* Experienced at research, evaluation and application of leading edge 
  technologies.
* Superior project management and people management skills.
* Effective written, verbal and customer communications abilities.
* Excellent at planning, implementing and meeting schedules in a time critical
  environment.
* Skilled at determining proper prioritization of tasks.
* Exceptional programming skills and experience, encompassing: user interface
  design, OO, multi-threaded applications, distributed applications, and
  kernel development.

Specialties: * Operating Systems: LINUX (Fedora/Redhat Slackware), UNIX (Solaris/SunOs) & Microsoft
  (Windows 95/98/ME/XP) installation, maintenance, configuration.
* Programming Languages: Java, JSP/Servlet, SWING, C, C++, JDBC, SQL
* Scripting: sh/ksh/bash (including sed, awk, cut, paste, etc.), make
* Web: HTML, DHTML, JavaScript, XML, XSD, Struts
* Relational Databases: Oracle, Informix
* Application Server: Tomcat, Apache, SSL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Engineer responsible for graphical product development and design. Manage 
teams of engineers, testers, and writers while participating in all phases of the software engineering lifecycle in a project- based outsourcing environment. 
Actively participate and contribute to development activities.
Responsibilities include: architecture, design, implementation, client 
liaison, and support.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Provided consulting and development expertise to AT&T's BCS Middle Market 
Business Division in the area of phone service provisioning and application 
debugging.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided technical leadership to the Digital UNIX Systems Management Group and 
Base OS Development Group.  Led and managed several projects across varying 
subsystems effectively, with a keen attention to time schedules and technical 
detail.
